scope: Send two concurrent authenticated POST /api/orders requests for the same active hold; prove both request handlers reach the Prisma transaction boundary before releasing either into the real transaction, then verify state convergence.

environment.seed: Demo seed applied after migration; test fixture uses unique customer, auditorium showtime, and hold

testMechanism: A test-scoped spy wraps callback transactions and holds the first two order transactions at a barrier. Both Supertest requests must reach this boundary within 10 seconds; the test then releases both to the real Prisma transaction. The spy is restored and pending requests are settled in finally.

assertions: Both requests returned 201 with the same order ID, total, and PAYMENT_PENDING status.
Exactly one order and one ORDER_CREATED audit were persisted.
The hold became PAYMENT_PENDING and the seat claim links to the order.
No payment or tickets were created.

additionalChecks.typecheckTests: Passed after adding the transaction barrier.
additionalChecks.traceability: 129 test cases / 29 requirements; all source links resolved.

limitations: This is local test-database evidence, not exact-source GitHub CI; CI will run after the test commit is pushed.
No production code change was required; the test initially exposed a shared-fixture leak, which was fixed by giving TC-PLAN-10 its own showtime and cleanup.
